headline: Approved 2027 meeting calendar, moving the November meeting to November 9, 2027 due to Election Day.
summary: Public comment covered a proposed sign for an artist's mural and two proposed lending libraries along the canal; no decisions were made on those. Members approved the September 1, 2026 minutes and the 2027 meeting calendar, each by a 5-0 roll call vote. Correspondence about a bollard near West Woods Road that reportedly fell was also discussed.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 1, 2026 meeting, 5-0.
Approved the amended 2027 meeting calendar, 5-0, with the November meeting moved to November 9, 2027.

TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Farmington Canal Commission 
Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
7:00 PM, October 6, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 The meeting was called to order by Commissioner N. Hansen at 7:02 PM. 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 The Clerk called the roll, and the following members were present: 
 
Present: 
 
Commissioner Nick Hansen 
Commissioner Peter Cyr 
Commissioner Kathy Larson 
Commissioner Jeffrey Campbell 
Commissioner Gerry Tobin 
 
Absent 
 
Commissioner David Schaefer, Chairman 
Commissioner David W. Radcliffe 
 
Also in attendance were Briana J. Belton-Robinson, Boards and Commissions Clerk, and 4 
members of the public, Judy Sirota Rosenthal, Violet Andrew, Elena Lindamood, Aaron 
Goode and Norm Berg, who attended virtually. 
 
Commissioner N. Hansen served as Acting Chair in Commissioner D. Schaefer's absence. 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 Acting Chairman N. Hasen requested a motion to adopt the minutes from Tuesday, 
September 1st, 2026. 
 
Commissioner K. Larson made the motion to amend the previous agenda, and 
Commissioner J. Campbell seconded it. 
 
Vote by Roll Call: 
 
Yes 
Commissioner Nick Hansen, Acting Chairman
Commissioner Peter Cyr 
Commissioner Kathy Larson 
Commissioner Jeffrey Campbell 
Commissioner Gerry Tobin 
 
No 
 
Absent 
Commissioner David Schaefer, Chairman 
Commissioner David Radcliffe 
 
The motion passed. 
 
• Roll Call Vote Summary: Yes 5, No 0, Abstentions 0, Absent 2 
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 Judy Sirota Rosenthal addressed the Commission regarding a portrait/mural of her late 
daughter, Sylvie (Sylvia) Sydney Rosenthal, an artist who grew up in Hamden, located 
along the Farmington Canal Trail near Dixwell Avenue and Putnam Avenue. Ms. Rosenthal 
asked about adding an informational sign or post, potentially including a QR code, so trail 
users could learn about her daughter's life and work. Commissioners expressed 
condolences and advised her to develop a proposal showing the proposed design, content, 
and location and submit it to the Commission. It was also noted that requests for 
installations along the trail generally involve the Planning and Zoning Office and may 
require additional Town approval. 
 
Violet Andrews, a UConn master's student and Difference Maker mentor, and Elena 
Lindamood, a Hamden High School student participating in the CAP program, presented a 
proposal to install two lending libraries along the canal. The proposed libraries would 
include environmentally focused books for children and teens, Spanish-language materials, 
and informational pamphlets about local parks, trails, and native species. Commissioners 
discussed possible locations and emphasized the need for a long-term maintenance and 
sustainability plan. Suggestions included exploring partnerships with Miller Memorial 
Library and the Hamden Land Conservation Trust. Ms. Andrews and Ms. Lindamood 
indicated that they would further develop the proposal and submit a written plan to the 
Commission. 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.   
 Acting Chairman N. Hansen summarized correspondence about a bollard just north of 
West Woods Road that reportedly fell after a trail user touched it. The Town forwarded the 
matter to staff. Parks Superintendent Tom Brown subsequently reported that Park 
Maintenance had secured the bollards. Commissioner Campbell asked whether the issue 
resulted from improper securing or a structural problem; Acting Chair Hansen stated that
the correspondence suggested the bollard had not been securely bolted, while noting that 
he had not witnessed the incident. 
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 No Executive Session was held. 
7. REPORTS   
 
 
  1. Report of the Chairman  
  Chairman D. Schaefer was absent. Acting Chairman N. Hansen reported that he had 
nothing additional to add beyond matters already discussed. 
8. LENDING LIBRARY DISCUSSION   
 The Commission noted that the lending library proposal had been discussed during Public 
Comment. No additional discussion was held. 
9. APPROVAL OF 2027 MEETING CALENDAR   
 The Commission reviewed the proposed 2027 meeting calendar, generally maintaining 
meetings at 7:00 PM on the first Tuesday of each month via Zoom, with no meeting in 
August. Because November 2, 2027 is Election Day, the Commission agreed to move the 
November meeting to Tuesday, November 9, 2027. July 6, 2027 will remain a placeholder 
for the Commission's traditional in-person summer meeting, with the date to be revisited 
closer to the meeting. 
 
Commissioner P. Cyr moved to approve the amended 2027 meeting calendar. 
Commissioner G. Tobin seconded the motion. 
 
Vote by Roll Call: 
 
Yes 
Commissioner Nick Hansen, Acting Chairman 
Commissioner Peter Cyr 
Commissioner Kathy Larson 
Commissioner Jeffrey Campbell 
Commissioner Gerry Tobin 
 
No 
 
Absent 
Commissioner David Schaefer, Chairman 
Commissioner David Radcliffe 
 
The motion passed. 
 
• Roll Call Vote Summary: Yes 5, No 0, Abstentions 0, Absent 2. 
 
10. OLD BUSINESS
Commissioner J. Campbell asked for an update regarding a grant opportunity for mile 
markers and whether Town branding could be included in addition to Greenway branding. 
Commissioner P. Cyr reported that efforts to obtain additional information had reached a 
dead end and that the application timeline appeared to have passed. 
11. NEW BUSINESS   
 No new business was presented. 
12. ADJOURNMENT   
 Commissioner P. Cyr made a motion to adjourn. Commissioner G. Tobin seconded the 
motion. 
 
The motion passed unanimously. 
 
The meeting adjourned at 7:38 PM.
